_description: Filter applied to the 'List Groups' connector activity (uipath.connector.uipath-microsoft-azureactivedirectory.list-groups) in the CeqlWhereTest flow. The 'where' parameter has design.component=FilterBuilder (CEQL) as confirmed by registry get connectorMethodInfo. This filter compiles to the CEQL string: displayName = 'active'
configureCommand: uip maestro flow node configure CeqlWhereTest.flow listGroups1 --detail '{"connectionId":"<UUID>","folderKey":"<FOLDER_KEY>","method":"GET","endpoint":"/groups","filter":{"groupOperator":0,"index":0,"filters":[{"id":"displayName","operator":"Equals","value":{"value":"active","rawString":"\"active\"","isLiteral":true}}],"groups":[]}}' --output json
openQuestions: A live Azure AD (Microsoft Entra) IS connection UUID must replace <UUID>
The Orchestrator folder key for that connection must replace <FOLDER_KEY>
Run: uip is connections list uipath-microsoft-azureactivedirectory --all-folders --output json  to discover both values
Re-run node configure with the resolved values to complete wiring and generate bindings_v2.json
